purpose: Describe how routed extraction outputs should map to KG node kinds, relationship types, graph anchor fields, and descriptive attributes.

current_graph_basis.mapping_rule: Evidence records become graph edges by normalized compound, normalized entity, entity_kind, relation_type, paper provenance, and evidence type.

compound.description: Psychedelic compound, psychoactive compound, active metabolite, prodrug, or compound class.

condition_indication.description: Specific clinical condition, diagnosis, or treatment indication.

symptom_problem.description: Symptom, symptom cluster, clinical problem, or broad outcome problem that is not a specific diagnosis.

safety_adverse_event.description: Adverse event, tolerability outcome, complication, safety signal, or risk.

outcome_scale.description: Clinical outcome instrument, questionnaire, rating scale, or endpoint measure.

target.description: Molecular target such as receptor, transporter, enzyme, ion channel, gene, or protein complex.

pathway_process.description: Molecular pathway, signaling process, cellular process, or biological process.

biomarker_readout.description: Internal compatibility kind for measured molecular readouts, biochemical readouts, ligand/readout measures, imaging/PET measures, or true biomarkers.

system_family.description: Broad mechanistic system or family, currently used for broad receptor families and system-level biology.

brain_region.description: Named anatomical brain region or subregion.

brain_network.description: Named functional brain network or connectivity-defined network.

neural_circuit.description: Named circuit, projection, or circuit-level relationship between brain regions.

cognitive_behavioral_construct.description: Cognitive construct, behavioral construct, task domain, or behavioral process.

subjective_experience_construct.description: Subjective or phenomenological construct such as mystical experience, ego dissolution, insight, awe, or challenging experience.

pharmacokinetic_parameter.description: True pharmacokinetic or exposure parameter such as Cmax, Tmax, AUC, half-life, clearance, bioavailability, concentration, or volume of distribution. Metabolites, enzymes, transporters, and metabolic pathways use their own node kinds.

intervention_component.description: Psychotherapy, preparation, integration, setting, therapist, care-delivery, or protocol component.

public_health_measure.description: Population-level measure, access/equity measure, policy measure, harm-reduction measure, use pattern, or public-health impact measure.

discusses_relationship.description: Secondary literature coverage of a compound-to-entity relationship.

has_pharmacokinetic_exposure.description: Legacy generic PK relationship. New primary evidence uses the specific PK relationship types below.

review_anchor_audit.finding: Sampled review routes support the current planned anchor list. The main schema-alignment risk is not missing broad node kinds, but collapsing distinct anchors into broad fields.

safety_tolerability: severity, discontinuation, monitoring, and mitigation context
molecular_target: receptors, transporters, enzymes, channels, genes, proteins, and target complexes
binding, agonism/antagonism, selectivity, and off-target evidence
molecular_pathway_readout: molecular readouts, candidate biomarkers, tissues, cell types, and model systems
brain_system: neural readouts such as activation, connectivity, oscillations, and imaging/PET measures
cognitive_behavioral: tasks, behavioral models, and task domains
subjective_experience: experience dimensions, valence, setting-linked experiences, and scale subdimensions
pharmacokinetics_exposure: analytes, metabolites, routes, formulations, and matrices
metabolic enzymes, transporters, and metabolic or transport pathways
intervention_context: preparation, dosing-session, integration, setting, provider, and protocol components
delivery, fidelity, implementation, access, and cultural adaptation context
real_world_public_health: abuse potential, harm reduction, access, equity, policy, service delivery, and epidemiology topics
population-level risks, benefits, estimates, and trends

schema_alignment_notes: Do not add schema fields only because reviews mention them; prefer fields that are graph anchors or useful edge attributes.
Split combined anchor fields during schema alignment where the graph needs separate node kinds, especially brain region, brain network, and neural circuit.

For pharmacokinetics/exposure, do not force analytes, metabolites, enzymes, transporters, and pathways into one PK-parameter node. Normalize analytes and metabolites as compounds where appropriate, enzymes and transporters as targets, and metabolic or transport pathways as pathway_process when the downstream mapper supports those cross-domain anchors.

For brain-system reviews, neural readouts can remain edge attributes at first, but imaging/PET/EEG measures that need graph queries can reuse the current biomarker_readout compatibility kind for molecular or neural readouts.

For public-health reviews, public_health_measure should be interpreted broadly enough to include stable public-health topics such as use patterns, abuse potential, harm reduction, access, equity, policy, service delivery, and epidemiology measures.

clinical_outcome.description: Compound or intervention evidence for clinical conditions, symptoms, endpoints, and outcome measures.
schema_cleanup_notes: Split disorder/condition from population or subgroup where possible.
Treat outcome measures as outcome_scale nodes only when the instrument itself is the useful graph target.
Use symptom_problem for broad symptoms such as depression, anxiety, pain, or sleep disturbance when they are not specific diagnoses.
Treat suicidality as a condition_indication when it is the studied clinical target, and as a safety_adverse_event only when framed as treatment-emergent or worsened risk.

safety_tolerability.description: Compound or exposure evidence for adverse events, tolerability, complications, and safety risks.
schema_cleanup_notes: Keep safety event labels graph-stable and put severity, rate, setting, and management details on the edge.

molecular_target.description: Compound evidence for molecular targets with binding, action, target-engagement, or target-pharmacology evidence.
schema_cleanup_notes: Keep target nodes to receptors, transporters, enzymes, channels, genes, proteins, or stable target complexes.
Put assay details and values on the edge, not in the node label.

molecular_pathway_readout.description: Compound evidence for pathways, processes, and measured molecular readouts.
schema_cleanup_notes: Map extraction value molecular_readout to KG entity_kind biomarker_readout until the internal compatibility key is renamed.
Use pathway_process for processes such as mTOR signaling or synaptogenesis, and biomarker_readout for measured molecular readouts such as BDNF expression or cytokine levels.
Retain the specific pathway or readout as the graph entity and store molecular_effect_category as its broad parent facet.

brain_system.description: Compound evidence for brain regions, functional networks, neural circuits, and brain-system readouts.
schema_cleanup_notes: Use brain_region, brain_network, and neural_circuit as separate graph anchors when the text supports the distinction.
Use biomarker_readout as a compatibility kind for neural measures such as imaging, PET, EEG, oscillation, activation, or connectivity readouts when the measure itself is the useful graph target.
Retain system_family only for broad compatibility until specific brain-system node kinds are fully wired into the KG projector.

cognitive_behavioral.description: Compound evidence for cognitive constructs, behavioral constructs, and task-level behavioral outcomes.
schema_cleanup_notes: Do not force cognitive/behavioral constructs into condition_indication unless the paper is actually about a clinical diagnosis.
Keep task and measurement details as edge attributes unless the task domain itself is the graph entity.

subjective_experience.description: Compound evidence for subjective, phenomenological, and acute experience constructs.
schema_cleanup_notes: Use subjective experience nodes for experience constructs, not for clinical symptoms or safety events.
Put outcome linkage and therapeutic-process claims on the edge.

pharmacokinetics_exposure.description: Compound evidence for pharmacokinetic, exposure, analyte, metabolite, route, and exposure-response findings.
schema_cleanup_notes: Use primary_graph_anchor_kind to state whether the target-side graph anchor is a PK parameter, compound/analyte/metabolite, target enzyme/transporter, or pathway/process.
Keep values, units, dose, route, sampling window, matrix, and population/system details as edge attributes.
Do not force metabolites, enzymes, transporters, or metabolic pathways into a generic pharmacokinetic_parameter label.

cross_domain_anchor_kinds.use: Metabolites, analytes, enantiomers, alkaloids, or active chemical species when the chemical entity is the graph target.
Metabolic enzymes, transporters, genes, proteins, or target complexes relevant to exposure.
Metabolic, transport, bioavailability, potentiation, or exposure-response pathways.

intervention_context.description: Evidence for psychotherapy, preparation, integration, setting, provider, protocol, delivery, and implementation components.
schema_cleanup_notes: Use intervention_component for stable care-delivery components; keep quantities, timing, fidelity, and implementation details as attributes.

real_world_public_health.description: Evidence for real-world use, access, equity, policy, harm reduction, epidemiology, service delivery, and public-health measures.
schema_cleanup_notes: Use public_health_measure for stable public-health measures or topics, including use patterns, abuse potential, harm reduction, access, equity, policy, service delivery, epidemiology, and population-level risks or benefits.
Put estimates, policy setting, equity context, data source, and implementation implications on the edge.

general_primary.description: Fallback primary extraction. Use only for audit or later manual assignment.
general_primary.no_graph_mapping_reason: General primary routes do not define a stable KG node kind or relationship type.

general_topic.description: Fallback secondary topic route. Use only for audit or later manual assignment.
general_topic.no_graph_mapping_reason: General secondary routes do not define a stable KG node kind or relationship type.

general_topic_coverage.description: Fallback secondary coverage route. Use only for audit or later manual assignment.
general_topic_coverage.no_graph_mapping_reason: General coverage routes do not define a stable KG node kind or relationship type.
